title: Will the U.S. Treasury announce a qualifying public-ledger payment by December 31, 2026?
resolution_rules: This project-authored synthetic market retains two deadline clauses. The primary clause requires a qualifying U.S. Treasury transaction on a public distributed ledger by December 31, 2026, 23:59 ET. A supplemental clause requires public announcement of an ordinary government payment by that deadline regardless of when the transaction occurred. Payments by the Treasury or an authorized Treasury sub-body or entity are in scope. Pilots, tests, and proofs of concept do not qualify. The fixture preserves both clauses without choosing between them; otherwise it resolves No.
